name: context-relevance-splunk-benchmarking
description: A benchmark for measuring how well models identify contextually relevant information in Splunk-style observability/logging scenarios. It evaluates model ability to rank or classify log snippets or context windows by relevance to a query or incident. Designed to help assess retrieval/ranking and contextual relevance performance for observability use cases.
evaluation_method: NDCG / ranking metrics (and accuracy/F1 for binary labels)
reputation: Small, specialized benchmark aimed at enterprise observability evaluation; limited broad adoption.
